items.details: Event weekend ran September 2-4, 2016 (annual Labor Day event). Writer flew 1.5 hrs from Los Angeles to Charles M. Schulz-Sonoma County Airport (Santa Rosa); Alaska Airlines non-stop from Orange County John Wayne Airport also mentioned. Car rental at Santa Rosa airport, then 45-minute drive to the hotel.
items.location: Los Angeles (LAX) to Sonoma County Airport (STS), Santa Rosa
items.name: Alaska Airlines to Santa Rosa

items.details: 45-minute picturesque drive from Sonoma County Airport; pain-free car rental service on site at the Santa Rosa airport.
items.name: Car rental at Sonoma County Airport

items.details: Stayed while covering the weekend for JohnnyJet.com. 226 guest rooms/suites renovated in 2013; historic 1920s Spanish mission-style hotel, no elevators (first-floor rooms). Rooms start at $499/night.
items.name: The Fairmont Sonoma Mission Inn & Spa

items.details: 40,000 sq ft spa on ancient thermal mineral springs; pools with underwater music, co-ed sauna with rock salt wall, steam room, soaking tubs, massage therapies, rain tunnel and meditation room. Entrance fee waived with a spa service; otherwise $39-$89.
items.location: The Fairmont Sonoma Mission Inn & Spa
items.name: Willow Stream Spa

items.details: VIP kickoff party for the weekend (last year held at Atwood Ranch; host Julie Atwood). Rustic barn setting with food by local chef Joshua Murray. Marks the start of the 3-day weekend.
items.name: Sonoma Wine Country Weekend kickoff party

items.details: Opening-night event at Francis Ford Coppola Winery: area restaurants and wineries showcase food, wine and dessert at stations around two pools (3,600 sq ft) and a cabana area; movie memorabilia gallery and bocce courts. Tickets $175 each.
items.name: Sonoma Starlight

items.details: Biggest daytime event of the weekend at MacMurray Estate Vineyards (once Fred MacMurray's cattle ranch). 200+ wineries pour thousands of wines; 60+ local chefs; sommelier tasting tours and BBQ demos. Tickets $82.50 each.
items.location: MacMurray Estate Vineyards, Russian River Valley
items.name: Taste of Sonoma

items.details: Final evening event of the weekend at historic Buena Vista Winery (California's first winery, 1850s wine caves). Proprietor Jean-Charles Boisset hosts; bubble lounge/champagne cellar a must. Gala is invitation-only; public tasting at the winery is $15.
items.name: Gala dinner at Buena Vista Winery

items.details: Main event of the weekend at Chateau St. Jean — Sonoma County's largest fundraiser, supporting area charities. Bidding on experiences around the world; vintner-hosted luncheon under the auction tent. Tickets $500 each.
items.name: Sonoma Harvest Wine Auction

itineraries.summary: Day-by-day account of the 3-day Sonoma Wine Country Weekend (Labor Day weekend) as covered for JohnnyJet.com: fly into Santa Rosa, base at The Fairmont Sonoma Mission Inn & Spa, and attend the weekend's ticketed events — kickoff party and Sonoma Starlight at Coppola Winery (Day 1), Taste of Sonoma and the Buena Vista gala dinner (Day 2), and the Sonoma Harvest Wine Auction at Chateau St. Jean (Day 3).
itineraries.title: 3 Days at Sonoma Wine Country Weekend

items.details: Bermuda's most popular beach: powder-soft pink sand, clear water, cove and climbable limestone formations with a bird's-eye overlook. Public restrooms and a snack bar called Beach House on site. Trip sponsored by the Bermuda Department of Tourism.
items.name: Horseshoe Bay Beach

items.details: Bermuda's longest beach at half a mile, less crowded than Horseshoe Bay; pale pink sand, blue waters, dramatic rock formations rising from the sea. Public restrooms on site; bring towel, sunscreen and a meal.
items.name: Warwick Long Bay Beach

items.details: Private beach next to Horseshoe Bay; snorkeling, kayaking and sailing available. Strawberry daiquiri ordered from hotel beach staff ($11), chargeable to the room. A 20-minute ferry ride back to The Fairmont Hamilton Princess hotel.
items.name: Fairmont Southampton private Beach Club

items.details: Mentioned as the return point after beach days — a 20-minute ferry ride from the Southampton beach back to this hotel. No stay details or room rates given.
items.name: The Fairmont Hamilton Princess

items.details: Bonus beach (not one of the 3 main days): Elbow Beach in Paget Parish; beachside buffet dinner at Lido restaurant with fish cakes, chicken, beef, grilled vegetables and creme brulee.
items.name: Lido restaurant

itineraries.summary: Leisurely 3-day Bermuda beach itinerary published on JohnnyJet.com (writer visited April 18-21): one beach per day — Horseshoe Bay Beach (Day 1), Warwick Long Bay Beach (Day 2), and the private Fairmont Southampton Beach Club with watersports and a $11 daiquiri (Day 3), plus a bonus dinner at Lido on Elbow Beach. Trip sponsored by the Bermuda Department of Tourism.
itineraries.title: 3 Beautiful Bermuda Beaches in 3 Days
